sentences.text: Researchers developed treatment plans using intensity-modulated radiotherapy to deliver a total dose of 30 Gy in 10 sessions, measuring radiation exposure to the target and sensitive structures like the hippocampi.
To assess the precision of these plans, they were delivered to a specialized detector array that is compatible with the MRI machine.
All plans met safety limits, with average target doses ranging from 26.85 Gy to 35.49 Gy and hippocampal doses between 8.07 Gy and 13.57 Gy.
The average agreement between planned and measured doses was 96.43%, supporting the authors' conclusion that creating these plans on the MRI-linac system is technically feasible.
